ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text:
Two pendulums 1 and 2 with different lengths are horizontally suspended on the same axis, with their swinging planes parallel to each other. The vibration patterns are shown in Figure A. At $t=0$, the bob of pendulum 1 is pulled to the left and the bob of pendulum 2 is pulled to the right to the same angle, as shown in Figure B.

1. Find the ratio of the lengths of the two simple pendulums $l_{1}:l_{2}$.
2. Release both pendulum balls simultaneously, and find the time it takes for both pendulum balls to swing to the far right at the same time.

ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: Figure A is the displacement-time graph of two simple pendulums, with the vertical axis as x/cm and the horizontal axis as t/s. The solid line is labeled simple pendulum 1; it starts from the equilibrium position and returns to the same phase of motion at t=1 s, so T1=1 s. The dashed line is labeled simple pendulum 2; it starts from the equilibrium position and returns to the same phase of motion at t=0.9 s, so T2=0.9 s. Figure B shows the instant of release: simple pendulum 1 is at the position of maximum deflection angle on the left side of the vertical line, and simple pendulum 2 is at the position of maximum deflection angle on the right side of the vertical line. Reasoning: The period of a simple pendulum satisfies T=2π√(l/g), so the pendulum length is proportional to the square of the period: l1:l2=T1^2:T2^2=1^2:0.9^2=1:0.81=100:81. When released, simple pendulum 1 is at the leftmost end; the first time it reaches the rightmost end requires half a period, namely T1/2=0.5 s, and thereafter it reaches the rightmost end every T1=1 s, therefore t=0.5+n, where n is a nonnegative integer. When simple pendulum 2 is released, it is already at the rightmost end; thereafter it reaches the rightmost end every T2=0.9 s, therefore t=0.9m, where m is a nonnegative integer. Combining 0.5+n=0.9m, multiplying by 10 gives 5+10n=9m. From modulo 9, n≡4 mod 9, so n=4+9k, substituting back gives t=0.5+4+9k=4.5+9k s, k=0,1,2,....

raw_record.question_text:
Two pendulums 1 and 2 with different lengths are horizontally suspended on the same axis, with their swinging planes parallel to each other. The vibration patterns are shown in Figure A. At t = 0, the bob of pendulum 1 is pulled to the left and the bob of pendulum 2 is pulled to the right to the same angle, as shown in Figure B.

1. Find the ratio of the lengths of the two simple pendulums l1:l2.
2. Release both pendulum balls simultaneously, and find the time it takes for both pendulum balls to swing to the far right at the same time.

method.method_draft: Read Figure A first: the solid curve labeled pendulum 1 starts from equilibrium and returns to the same phase at t = 1 s, so T1 = 1 s; the dashed curve labeled pendulum 2 returns to the same phase at t = 0.9 s, so T2 = 0.9 s. Use the simple pendulum relation T = 2π√(l/g), hence l1:l2 = T1^2:T2^2 = 1^2:0.9^2 = 100:81. Then read Figure B: at release, pendulum 1 is at the left extreme and pendulum 2 is at the right extreme. Pendulum 1 reaches the far right after T1/2 plus any integer number of T1, so t = 0.5 + n. Pendulum 2 reaches the far right every full period, so t = 0.9m. Solve 0.5 + n = 0.9m for nonnegative integers, giving t = 4.5 + 9k s.
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：图甲是两个单摆的位移—时间图，纵轴为 x/cm，横轴为 t/s。实线标注为单摆1，它从平衡位置出发，并在 t=1 s 回到相同运动相位，所以 T1=1 s。虚线标注为单摆2，它从平衡位置出发，并在 t=0.9 s 回到相同运动相位，所以 T2=0.9 s。图乙显示释放瞬间：单摆1在竖直线左侧的最大偏角位置，单摆2在竖直线右侧的最大偏角位置。

推理：简单摆周期满足 T=2π√(l/g)，所以摆长与周期平方成正比：l1:l2=T1^2:T2^2=1^2:0.9^2=1:0.81=100:81。释放时单摆1在最左端，它第一次到最右端需半个周期，即 T1/2=0.5 s，以后每隔 T1=1 s 到达最右端，因此 t=0.5+n，其中 n为非负整数。单摆2释放时就在最右端，以后每隔 T2=0.9 s 到达最右端，因此 t=0.9m，其中 m为非负整数。联立 0.5+n=0.9m，乘以10得 5+10n=9m。由模9可得 n≡4 mod 9，所以 n=4+9k，代回得 t=0.5+4+9k=4.5+9k s，k=0,1,2,...。

method.method_draft: Read Figure A as a phase clock: pendulum 1 has period 1 s and pendulum 2 has period 0.9 s, so in units of 0.1 s their periods are 10 units and 9 units. Therefore l1:l2 = 10^2:9^2 = 100:81. From Figure B, pendulum 1 begins at the left extreme, so it is at the right extreme when the elapsed time in 0.1 s units is congruent to 5 modulo 10. method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：图甲是位移 x/cm 随时间 t/s 变化的振动图像，实线标为单摆1，虚线标为单摆2；从图中读出单摆1的周期为 1 s，单摆2的周期为 0.9 s。图乙中，两摆悬挂在同一轴上，单摆1的摆球在左侧极端位置，单摆2的摆球在右侧极端位置。

ready3_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: Two pendulums 1 and 2 with different lengths are horizontally suspended on the same axis, with their swinging planes parallel to each other. The vibration patterns are shown in Figure A. At t = 0, the bob of pendulum 1 is pulled to the left and the bob of pendulum 2 is pulled to the right to the same angle, as shown in Figure B. 1. Find the ratio of the lengths of the two simple pendulums l1:l2. 2. Release both pendulum balls simultaneously, and find the time it takes for both pendulum balls to swing to the far right at the same time.
ready3_open_rewrite.final_cot:
Image description: Figure A is the displacement-time graph of two simple pendulums, with the vertical axis as x/cm and the horizontal axis as t/s. The solid line is labeled simple pendulum 1; it starts from the equilibrium position and returns to the same phase of motion at t=1 s, so T1=1 s. The dashed line is labeled simple pendulum 2; it starts from the equilibrium position and returns to the same phase of motion at t=0.9 s, so T2=0.9 s. Figure B shows the instant of release: simple pendulum 1 is at the position of maximum deflection angle on the left side of the vertical line, and simple pendulum 2 is at the position of maximum deflection angle on the right side of the vertical line.

Reasoning: The period of a simple pendulum satisfies T=2π√(l/g), so the pendulum length is proportional to the square of the period: l1:l2=T1^2:T2^2=1^2:0.9^2=1:0.81=100:81. When released, simple pendulum 1 is at the leftmost end; the first time it reaches the rightmost end requires half a period, namely T1/2=0.5 s, and thereafter it reaches the rightmost end every T1=1 s, therefore t=0.5+n, where n is a nonnegative integer. When simple pendulum 2 is released, it is already at the rightmost end; thereafter it reaches the rightmost end every T2=0.9 s, therefore t=0.9m, where m is a nonnegative integer. Combining 0.5+n=0.9m, multiplying by 10 gives 5+10n=9m. From modulo 9, n≡4 mod 9, so n=4+9k, substituting back gives t=0.5+4+9k=4.5+9k s, k=0,1,2,....
